verdict.rationale: Runloop has a dedicated network-policies doc explicitly stating 'Control egress network access for your Devboxes,' directly matching the platform-engineer story of restricting/allowing sandbox egress. However, the evidence is a single thin doc snippet with no detail on policy granularity (allow/deny lists, protocols) and no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed policy configuration examples, verification that granular rules work in practice, independent confirmation.
